result.summary: Both targets exit non-zero. Compilation errors from rework 0 FULLY RESOLVED by commit 5b52a46 (Tag type simplified to []const u8, @ptrCast removed). BACKEND-DEV SQL fix (commit b8163cb, scope killIdleConnections by per-process owner tag) is VERIFIED WORKING against the real Postgres database. Two new runtime issues surfaced: (1) BLOCKER — TC-ISS-0602-cross-01 test logic defect: the test deliberately parks a sibling-tagged connection, but the defensive cross-owner check inside killIdleConnections then flags that same sibling as unexpected and returns error.OwnerTagMismatch; (2) MAJOR — DebugAllocator leak in TestHarness.init via generateOwnerTag (16-byte tag storage kept in file-scope tag_repr_storage for process lifetime, not freed on harness deinit). The leak is pre-existing and was masked previously by compilation failures; affects every TestHarness-based test.

issues.summary: TC-ISS-0602-cross-01 fails: defensive cross-owner check flags test-introduced sibling
issues.description: Test parks sibling-tagged connection (uid_siblingtag00) in idle-in-tx, then calls helpers.killIdleConnections(&h.conn, h.tag). Kill predicate correctly excludes sibling (application_name differs). Defensive check at end of killIdleConnections then queries pg_stat_activity for idle-in-tx connections with application_name <> tag, finds count=1 (the parked sibling the test itself created), returns error.OwnerTagMismatch. The SQL fix itself is correct; the regression test has order-dependent logic that contradicts the defensive post-check invariant.

issues.summary: DebugAllocator leak in TestHarness.init via generateOwnerTag
issues.description: generateOwnerTag allocates 16 bytes (TEST_OWNER_TAG_PREFIX.len=4 + TEST_OWNER_TAG_HEX_CHARS=12) and stores slice in file-scope tag_repr_storage (intentional process-lifetime). TestHarness does not track this allocator/storage, so h.deinit() cannot free it. DebugAllocator reports the still-live allocation as a leak and exits 1 even when test assertions pass. Affects every TestHarness-based test across the integration suite.
